scripts.build: pnpm --filter @waha-command-center/config build && pnpm --filter @waha-command-center/domain build && pnpm --filter @waha-command-center/waha-contracts build && pnpm --filter @waha-command-center/api build && pnpm --filter @waha-command-center/web build
scripts.dev:bundled: docker compose -p relaynest-dev -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f docker-compose.bundled-waha.yml --profile waha up --build --wait -d
scripts.deploy:bundled: docker compose -p relaynest -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f docker-compose.bundled-waha.yml --profile waha up --build --wait -d
scripts.deploy:external: docker compose -p relaynest -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f docker-compose.external-waha.yml up --build --wait -d
scripts.deploy:down: docker compose -p relaynest -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml --profile waha down --remove-orphans
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm audit --audit-level=high && pnpm run verify:requirements && pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run verify:scope && pnpm run docs:check
